districts.name: Shaniwar Wada Area
districts.description: Historic area surrounding the majestic Shaniwar Wada fort, seat of the Peshwa rulers. This area is rich in history, traditional Maharashtrian architecture, and cultural significance.

districts.name: J.M. Road Area
districts.description: Jungli Maharaj Road - popular college area filled with bookstores, cafes, and youth culture. Known for its Marathi bookshops and intellectual atmosphere.

unlockRequirement.description: Reach 500 XP to explore J.M. Road area

districts.name: Camp Area
districts.description: Historical British cantonment area with beautiful architecture, churches, and wide tree-lined streets. Known for its old-world charm and military history.

morning.description: Morning walks and military parade practice

evening.description: Beautiful sunset views, ideal for leisurely walks

night.description: Quiet and serene, perfect for contemplative strolls

districts.name: Koregaon Park
districts.description: Upscale residential area known for its organic cafes, boutiques, and international cuisine. Popular among expatriates and young professionals.

unlockRequirement.description: Reach 2,000 XP to explore Koregaon Park

afternoon.description: Quieter afternoon, perfect for leisurely browsing

districts.name: Deccan Gymkhana
districts.description: Residential and commercial area known for its educational institutions, hospitals, and the famous Deccan Gymkhana club.

unlockRequirement.description: Reach 3,000 XP to explore Deccan Gymkhana

afternoon.description: Regular hospital visits and academic activities

districts.name: Sinhagad Road
districts.description: Scenic route leading to Sinhagad Fort, famous for its agricultural produce, especially vegetables and fruits, and traditional Maharashtrian cuisine.

unlockRequirement.description: Reach 4,000 XP to explore Sinhagad Road

morning.description: Early market activity and farming work

districts.name: Jangli Maharaj Road
districts.description: Another name for J.M. Road area, focusing on its cultural and educational significance as a student hub with numerous coaching classes and bookstores.

unlockRequirement.description: Reach 1,500 XP to explore Jangli Maharaj Road

night.description: Most classes end, some self-study continues

districts.name: Laxmi Road
districts.description: One of Pune's oldest and busiest commercial streets, famous for its jewelry shops, traditional clothing stores, and bustling market atmosphere.

unlockRequirement.description: Reach 2,500 XP to explore Laxmi Road

afternoon.description: Peak shopping hours for household essentials

evening.description: Festive atmosphere, ideal for wedding shopping

night.description: Most shops close, some food stalls remain open

districts.name: Fergusson College Road
districts.description: Educational hub named after the prestigious Fergusson College, featuring academic institutions, student accommodations, and lively street culture.

unlockRequirement.description: Reach 3,500 XP to explore Fergusson College Road

afternoon.description: Labs, practicals, and group study sessions

evening.description: Assignment completion and project work peak

night.description: Library lights on, some late-night studying

districts.name: M.G. Road
districts.description: Mahatma Gandhi Road - one of Pune's main arterial roads connecting various parts of the city, lined with commercial establishments, banks, and restaurants.

unlockRequirement.description: Reach 4,500 XP to explore M.G. Road

night.description: Steady flow of late diners and night-shift workers

districts.name: D.P. Road
districts.description: Datatransfer Prohibited Road - popular shopping destination known for its street fashion, junk food joints, and youthful vibe.

unlockRequirement.description: Reach 5,000 XP to explore D.P. Road

morning.description: Slow start, mostly setup and preparation

evening.description: Peak hangout time for teenagers and young adults
